changelog: Fixed WhatsApp-Style Call Screen: Resolved CSS flex override so Accept and Cut/Decline immediately dismiss the overlay and stop ringtone.
Auto-Expiring Stale Call Signaling: Incoming calls older than 45s are ignored automatically, completely preventing ghost ringing on launch.
Employee Directory & Kanban Filters: Restored search text, department pills, and status dropdown filtering across workers and task boards.
Central Files Support: Expanded document filtering to recognize .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .pptx, .csv, .zip, .md, and code files.
Optimized Voice & Image Sync: Added client-side image canvas compression (<120KB) and Opus voice memos for instant cloud transfers.
